description.en: SlowMist Agent Security guard plugin. Reviews external MCP calls, skill loads, URLs and fetched documents, code repositories and on-chain addresses before execution, emits SlowMist-style risk reports and blocks high-risk calls in enforce mode.
description.zh: 接入慢雾 Agent 安全审查流程的防护插件。在执行前审查外部 MCP 调用、技能加载、URL 与外部文档、代码仓库和链上地址，输出慢雾风格风险报告，并在 enforce 模式下阻断高风险调用。
